body:
**Investigation (2026-10-20 ~20:00Z, from the gateway pod; sources: `GET /zen/go/v1/models`, `GET /catalog/opencode`, console `/api/v2/config`, models.dev `api.json`).**

Counts: rail serves **37**, catalog lists **29** (all 29 rows `listed: true`), extra **8**, listed-but-unserved **0**. The rail's `/models` rows carry only `id · object · created · owned_by` — `created` is the same value on all 37 (the response time), no price/context/limit fields. The console's `opencode-go` overlay is **empty** (`models: {}`), so today's 29 = models.dev `opencode-go` (33) − its 4 `deprecated` rows, nothing else; the console's `opencode` overlay is 41 rows carrying only `disabled: true` (40) or `package` (1).

| id | class | models.dev `opencode-go` | models.dev `opencode` (PAYG) | console `opencode` overlay | served by the rail? | priced anywhere? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `minimax-m2.7` | **A** | `deprecated` (2026-03-18) | row, $0.3/$1.2 | `disabled` | listed by `/models`, not probed | go row + PAYG row |
| `glm-5.1` | C | — | row, 2026-04-07, $1.4/$4.4 | `disabled` | **200**, 1 token | PAYG row only |
| `grok-4.6` | C | — | row, 2026-08-12, $2/$6 | `disabled` | not probed | PAYG row only |
| `kimi-k2.6` | C | — | row, 2026-04-21, $0.95/$4 | `disabled` | not probed | PAYG row only |
| `minimax-m2.5` | C | — | row, 2026-02-12, $0.3/$1.2 | `disabled` | not probed | PAYG row only |
| `qwen3.6-plus` | C | — | row, 2026-04-02, $0.5/$3 | absent | not probed | PAYG row only |
| `qwen3.7-max` | C | — | — (models.dev has it only under `alibaba`, `302ai`, `abacus`, …) | absent | **200**, 1 token (+489 reasoning tokens billed) | nowhere under the vendor |
| `omen-alpha` | C | — | — (absent from all of models.dev) | absent | probed; status not captured (output truncated, not re-run) | nowhere |

So the issue's "the deprecated four among them" does not hold: of models.dev's 4 deprecated go rows only `minimax-m2.7` is served — `cat-jam-free`, `space-bunny`, `step-5-preview-free` are deprecated AND absent from `/models` (the only ids models.dev knows that the rail does not serve). Class B is empty. Class C splits three ways:

- **C1 — PAYG-retired carry-overs** (`glm-5.1`, `grok-4.6`, `kimi-k2.6`, `minimax-m2.5`, and the A row): never a go row, the console disables them on the pay-as-you-go provider, yet the Go rail still serves them (`glm-5.1` answered 200). models.dev's PAYG row is the only price.
- **C2 — PAYG-live, never Go** (`qwen3.6-plus`): a priced PAYG model the rail serves under the Go key with no go row.
- **C3 — unknown to the vendor's catalogs** (`qwen3.7-max`, `omen-alpha`): no models.dev row under either provider, no overlay row; `qwen3.7-max` serves and spends reasoning tokens. Launch / stealth ids models.dev has not caught up with (or never will).

What each would mean for a ruling (options only):
- **A** (deprecated-but-served): list with a `deprecated` flag so the view says `served: true, listed: false, deprecated: 2026-03-18` — vs keep unlisted and let the 3 unserved deprecated ids show the vendor does eventually pull them.
- **C1/C2** (a PAYG price exists, no Go limit row): the Go price is a plan fee over a monthly limit, and these have no limit row, so a PAYG per-token price is not a Go price (ruling 4) — options: a third price-less read of `/models` marking `served: true/false` per id (admission still defers `not-in-catalog`), vs reading the PAYG row as a stated *reference* price with a distinct `price_basis`, vs nothing (the rail serving an id is not an allowance).
- **C3** (no row anywhere): only the served flag is knowable; a `/models` read would give the operator the id and the date it appeared, and the shadow cells / 4xx belts remain the liveness signal — vs wait for models.dev to catch up (it has no `omen-alpha` at all today).

Note: the 1-token probes cost two rounds (a first round answered 400 `MissingSessionID` at the edge — the rail requires `x-opencode-session` on completions too, unmetered; the second round was accidentally executed twice, so 6 metered calls, not 3).
